label_note: Labels represent application traffic categories from VNAT dataset. VPN/non-VPN binary distinction is NOT available in this feature file; it requires the 32GB PCAP archive.

excluded_features.log_total_outgoing_bytes: Identical to log_total_outgoing_packets in all 15,093 rows (100.00% equality, Pearson r=1.0). Provides zero independent signal.
excluded_features.log_total_incoming_bytes: Identical to log_total_incoming_packets in all 15,093 rows (100.00% equality, Pearson r=1.0). Provides zero independent signal.
excluded_features.flow_iat_min: Definition mismatch: dataset uses chronological cross-direction consecutive-packet IATs; analyzer.py concatenates per-direction lists. flow_iat_min < min(out_iat_min, in_iat_min) in 71.7% of rows (10,824/15,093).
excluded_features.flow_iat_max: Same mismatch as flow_iat_min (cross-direction vs per-direction IAT).
excluded_features.flow_iat_mean: Same mismatch as flow_iat_min (cross-direction vs per-direction IAT).
excluded_features.flow_iat_std_dev: Same mismatch as flow_iat_min (cross-direction vs per-direction IAT).

validation_scope_note: These metrics reflect held-out test-set performance on deduplicated VNAT feature vectors ONLY. They are NOT real-world PCAP performance estimates. Pre-dedup: 15,093 rows. Exact duplicates removed: 197. Post-dedup: 14,896. Split: stratified 80/20, random_state=42. Session-grouped split was NOT possible (no flow IDs in feature file). Real-world PCAP accuracy may differ due to: heuristic direction inference on ESP-encrypted flows, high variance in short captures, and controlled lab vs production traffic differences. flow_iat_* features excluded due to confirmed training-inference mismatch. V2 is NOT claimed to be more accurate on real traffic than V1.
